english.title: In course of business without sufficient consent possess an illicit recording with a view to infringing rights
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without sufficient consent, possessed, in the course of business, with a view to committing an act infringing rights conferred by Chapter 2 of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988, a recording of **(..SPECIFY THE RECORDING..) which was, and which you knew or had reason to believe was, an illicit recording
english.legislation: Contrary to section 198(1)(c) and (6) of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence came into force on 1st February 2006 by Statutory Instrument 2006/18.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
